|'''Boris Becker'''

== 70% ==
Fiona and James are married. Fiona is always grumpy on a day that has an S in it. And James is always grumpy on a day that has an M in it. What is the only day of the week they are both happy?

'''Friday''': Tue'''s'''day, Wedne'''s'''day, Thur'''s'''day, '''S'''aturday, '''S'''unday are bad for Fiona and '''M'''onday is bad for James.

== 30% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |A group of soldiers are on the parade ground, standing to attention and facing west. The sergeant orders them to “Right turn! About-turn! Left turn!” Which direction are they facing now?
|-
|North
| South 
|'''East'''
|West
|}
They start facing west, then turn right so are facing north. After the about-turn, they are facing south and finally with a left turn, they are facing east.

{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |What number should appear on the blank square?
|-
|'''4'''
|5
|7

It is the number of letters in the background colour that determines the number. Pink is 4, Green is 5, Red is 3, Yellow is 6 so Blue must be 4.

== 5% ==
Which arrow is the odd one out?

[[File:Odd one out.png|frameless]]

'''8''': It is the only arrow that doesn’t point to at least one other arrow.

==1%==
In the following sequence, what do the letters V and C stand for?

VCCCVCCCVCCCCCVCCCCCVCCCCC

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

'''Vowel and Consonant''': The sequence represents the 26 letters in the alphabet.
